{{Quote|Nice cropduster!!!|Toy Dampner|translated=1|audio=ToyDampner.flac|<ref name="E1R" />}}
A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''blue-skinned and short-legged beings''' with conical heads existed, one of which was the notable [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Toy Dampner]]. The species could exhibit [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] on their heads, and featured short [[Limb/Legends|legs]] in conjunction with long, skinny arms. A crowd favorite on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], Dampner served as an example of his kind in the public spotlight.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Toy_Dampner.png|thumb|left|150px|The species exhibited a cone-shaped head with beady white eyes.]]
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned [[Species/Legends|species]], the aliens exhibited conical heads atop thin necks posted upon slim bodies. Alongside these proportions, the species exhibited short [[Limb/Legends|legs]] that ended in four digits. Conversely, the aliens possessed long, thin arms that ended in three-digit hands.<ref name="E1R" />

The species had the ability to grow red-colored [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that sprouted from the top of their skull. In addition, they could grow facial hair that could flourish into a full mustache and beard, the former of which would grow underneath a sizable nose. Above the nose were two beady white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="E1R" />

The species afforded the vocal ability to speak [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="E1R" />

==History==
The blue-skinned species evolved somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The species had become a part of the galactic community<ref name="E1R" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref>

==The species in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Toy Dampner joins the pack in a black and white Turca Special. Whoo, he looks fast!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]], a Podrace commentator|audio=Fode-ToyDampner2.flac|<ref name="E1R" />}}
A favorite among the [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] fans on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], the [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Toy Dampner]] was a public member of the species. During the final [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Dampner made a name for himself by becoming the crowd favorite of the Oovo IV racecourse [[Executioner (course)/Legends|Executioner]].<ref name="E1R" />

Although not an inmate of the Oovo IV [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that the course ran through, Dampner raced for the entertainment of his friends who were incarcerated there.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Dampner was also a crowd favorite on a [[Baroonda drag course 2|racecourse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]].<ref name="E1R2">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] [[Wikipedia:Game Boy Color|Game Boy Color]] version</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Red_Dampner.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Terryl Whitlatch's concept art for Toy Dampner depicted the character as short-furred and entirely red.]]
The species was originally conceived for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] for the early script character Toy Dampner. What eventually became the alien's final design was influenced by the [[1996]]-dated artwork of conceptual artists [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Iain McCaig]]. Labeled as "Jug-Head" Podracer by McCaig, the species never appeared in the film,<ref name="IG">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> but was instead developed for the film's tie-in [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''.<ref name="E1R" />

The game's design borrowed from both Whitlatch's and McCaig's artwork in that the game character was blue-skinned with red hair; Whitlatch's artwork depicted the species as being short-furred and completely red, while McCaig's design featured a clothed, blue-skinned and blue-haired character.<ref name="E1R" /><ref name="IG" />
